entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-21
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Multi-arch container publish compiles every referenced project once per architecture, into one output folder (CS2012 in parallel) #57267
  • Multi-arch container publish fails with MSB4184 when a label value contains ';', such as a project Description #57266
  • dotnetup PowerShell profile block adds ~0.5 s to every shell startup #57261
  • AffectedTests: make the 128 MiB test-map limit configurable (or split the map) #57260

PullRequests

Created

  • dotnetup: write env lines into the shell profile instead of running env script #57264
  • dotnetup: skip telemetry for env script #57263
  • dotnetup: avoid slow cmdlets in the PowerShell profile block #57262

Merged

  • [release/11.0.2xx] Disable NuGet audit in SDK test processes #57231

Updated

  • [release/11.0.2xx] Remove Ubuntu 22.04 from pipelines #57203
    Servicing-approved

    Servicing-approved
